name: Mouzh Message
author: Mouzh Hossain Shad

sections.description: Display customizable messages on your WordPress site to alert, notify, or inform users with ease.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mouzh-message directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure and use the plugin via the settings page or shortcode.
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

After activation, go to the plugin settings page to customize your message. Use the provided shortcode to display the message anywhere on your site.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, Mouzh Message is designed to work with all modern WordPress themes.

Is there any shortcode available?

Yes, the plugin provides a shortcode to place messages on specific pages or posts.
